method: Viewed original source artwork, corrected producer masks/native crops, independently extracted source-plus-eight native-resolution motion samples and last-two/first-two seam crops. Fully decoded all 84 frames per video and independently recomputed adjacent-frame, seam, inside/outside-mask, regional and brightness metrics. SHA-256 verified before/after decode and at report writing.
limitations: Full-speed playback and audio audition unassessed.
Approval covers exact-SHA sampled visuals and full-decode metrics only, not integrated product experience or production readiness.

scenes.scope: Exact-SHA sampled visuals and independent full-decode metrics; full-speed playback and audio unassessed
findings: Review 10 duplicated front-candle flame is resolved. Source artwork, corrected masks, eight native-resolution samples and seam crops show exactly one original front flame and one original shelf flame. Both candle regions have exactly zero temporal change across all 84 decoded frames.

Only the existing right-side incense vapor changes. It stays transparent and anchored near its source; door hardware, botanical strands, burner and surrounding geometry remain stable in inspected samples. No exposed mask edge or doubled rigid object is visible.

Independent full decode reproduces the producer metrics: seam ratio 1.716012, outside-mask change 0.00004014 and peak brightness step 0.003655 on a 0–255 scale. Vapor region mean adjacent-frame change 0.475841 confirms retained motion.
followUps: Verify repeated full-speed playback and audition integrated ambience.

scenes.scope: Exact-SHA sampled visuals and independent full-decode metrics; full-speed playback and audio unassessed
findings: Review 09 ghosted pier posts and cliff edge are resolved. Source artwork, revised masks, eight native-resolution samples and last-two/first-two seam crops preserve the original single pier, cliff, fence and doorway outlines.

The revised water regions are small and confined to open water. Inspected the tiny doorway-water region and surrounding railing at native resolution: no visible rectangular boundary, duplicated railing or displacement appears. Water movement is extremely restrained; cup steam supplies most visible motion. Full-speed review should assess whether this feels sufficiently alive.

Independent full decode reproduces seam ratio 0.928996, outside-mask change 0.00007812 and peak brightness step 0.011892 on a 0–255 scale. Tiny-water region mean adjacent-frame change 0.018902 and steam region 0.395325 confirm nonzero intended motion.
followUps: Verify repeated full-speed playback and audition integrated ambience.
